_comment: PRD decision rule 6, owned by the orchestrator (unlike categories.json, which is shared with ticketing). These rules apply last and can only TIGHTEN a decision: switch approval on, or force an escalation. They can never switch approval off or turn an escalation into an SR. Category ids and fields are validated against categories.json at load.

force_approval.note: Production restarts need service-owner approval (KB: Application restart policy).
An SR in this category is a dispute, and disputes need approval (KB: Commission payout schedule and disputes).
